# 2. Final check before you submit

1. Every `[TO COMPLETE]` below is filled or deliberately removed.
2. The title, version number and date are the same on every document.
3. The study codes, numbers of participants (8 to 10) and the eight movements are the same everywhere.
4. The statement "no video, image or landmark coordinates are stored" is true for what you will actually run (or you have added the optional module and say so everywhere).
5. Your commercial interest is stated in the protocol, the cover letter, the declaration and the consent forms.
6. The Roman Urdu texts have been read by a fluent speaker; the Urdu-script version exists if required.
7. The references have been checked against the originals.
8. The jurisdiction-specific items (regulatory position, data protection, retention) are checked with your institution.
9. Every signature and date is present.
10. You have kept a copy of everything submitted.
